notice.noActiveFile: No active file to archive or restore.
notice.noTargets: No files or folders to archive or restore.
notice.mixedTargets: Select only items to archive, or only items to restore.
notice.missingArchiveRoot: Set an archive location in settings first.
notice.invalidRule: Routing rule {index} needs different, non-overlapping source and destination folders before it can be enabled.
error.archivePathConflict: Archive path conflict: {path} already exists and is not a folder.
settings.language.name: Language
settings.language.desc: Choose the language used in settings, commands, and notices.
settings.archiveLocation.name: Archive location
settings.archiveLocation.desc: Choose the global fallback used when no routing rule matches, or when a rule destination does not allow restore.
settings.archiveSubfolderName.name: Subfolder name
settings.archiveSubfolderName.desc: When archiving near the original location, create this subfolder inside the current folder; if a matching archive location already exists in a parent folder, reuse it.
settings.archiveFolderPath.name: Archive folder path
settings.archiveFolderPath.desc: When archiving into a specified folder, use this folder as the starting point and preserve the original path under it.
settings.rules.name: Routing rules
settings.rules.desc: Rules are checked from top to bottom. The first matching source folder overrides the global archive destination.
settings.rules.empty: No routing rules. All items use the global archive location.
settings.rules.source.name: Source folder
settings.rules.source.desc: Match this folder and everything below it. Source and destination folders cannot overlap.
settings.rules.destination.name: Destination folder
settings.rules.destination.desc: Move the matched item here while preserving its path relative to the source folder.
settings.rules.restore.name: Allow restore
settings.rules.restore.desc: When enabled, running the action at the rule destination restores the item. When disabled, it archives directly with the global fallback.
settings.conflict.name: Conflict behavior
settings.conflict.desc: Choose what happens when the target already has a file or folder with the same name.
settings.ribbon.name: Show left toolbar button
settings.ribbon.desc: Add an archive button to the left toolbar.
settings.fileMenu.name: Add to context menu
settings.fileMenu.desc: Add an archive action to file, folder, and multi-selection context menus in the file explorer.
